# Requests mcp-publisher 1.8.7 sends, recorded against a logging stand-in
# with token.json {"method":"none","registry":"<root>"} (root = /mcp/<repo>).
# Columns: command, method, path below <root>, whether Authorization is sent.
# tests/formats/test-mcp.sh replays these with curl, so a publisher bump that
# changes its wire fails at this pin instead of somewhere in the gate.
# Note the publisher uses the /v0 alias, not /v0.1.
validate	POST	/v0/validate	no
publish	POST	/v0/publish	yes
status	GET	/v0/servers/{enc}/versions/{version}?include_deleted=true	yes
status	PATCH	/v0/servers/{enc}/versions/{version}/status	yes
status --all-versions	GET	/v0/servers/{enc}/versions?include_deleted=true	yes
